title: 招聘技能匹配
problem_statement_md:
你正在开发一个招聘平台，它根据候选人的技能来匹配合适工作岗位和候选人。
工作所需的技能和候选人的技能都存储在集合中。

完善程序，输出所以匹配的技能，每个匹配的技能均换行输出。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Sets[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working on a recruitment platform, which should match the available jobs and the candidates based on their skills.
The skills required for the job, and the candidate's skills are stored in [b]sets[/b].
Complete the program to output the matched skill.
[note]You can use the [b]intersect[/b] operator to get the values present in both sets.[/note]
hint_md: 可使用**intersect**操作符来获得两个集合的交集
